description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hitthetiya-East, Matara D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820004
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land titles for various parcels in Matara District. It contains detailed information about land parcels, ownership details, property boundaries, encumbrances, and servitude rights, which falls squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
